comment: Row #19 says the record "shall" work offline. "Shall" means required. But the status beside it says "Recommended", which means optional. The two do not match. The three comparable rows (Computable Decision Support Engine #25 p.189, Health Management Information System #21 p.216, Public Health Surveillance Platform #21 p.226) say "should" and are marked Recommended, so those are consistent. Only row #19 contradicts itself.
